_about: Which OCR model reads which kind of page best, shown under the Processor's OCR model picker (W41.app-ocr-hierarchy). Every figure is copied from the file named in its source, and scripts/test-ocr-page-guidance.sh checks it against that file. From W41-answers.md section 2. app_model is the Processor's LLMModel id when the app offers that model; omit it when it does not.
footnote: Measured on one corpus, about 100 pages; the reference text was drafted by Claude and Gemini, which may flatter both. Scores are out of 100: how closely a model's text matches the reference text, word for word (normalized edit similarity, NES); 100 is an exact match.

kinds.label: Printed or typeset
kinds.note: Gemini refused two of these pages; the app sends a refused page to a second model.

kinds.note: Only 4 pages, so treat this as a hint.

kinds.note: Any of the leading models scores 95 or more.
